mapper.select: SELECT * FROM byai_group_chat_turn WHERE group_session_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY execution_id
SELECT * FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE group_session_id = #{groupId} AND status != 'CONVERSATION' ORDER BY execution_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai_group_chat_recall_stop (execution_id, session_id, initiator_user_id, trace_id, task_owned, status) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{sessionId}, #{initiatorUserId}, #{traceId}, #{taskOwned}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM byai_group_chat_recall_stop WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
SELECT * FROM byai_group_chat_recall_stop WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY execution_id
SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM byai_group_chat_recall_stop WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND session_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY session_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE byai_group_chat_recall_stop SET status = 'DONE' WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
UPDATE byai_group_chat_turn SET status = 'CANCELLED', error_code = 'MESSAGE_RECALLED', finish_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE byai_group_chat_execution SET status = 'CANCELLED', error_code = 'MESSAGE_RECALLED', finish_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
